name: Luxembourg UCITS Law of 17 December 2010 (+ Part II UCIs)
reference: Law of 17 December 2010 — relating to undertakings for collective investment

articles.title: UCITS — definition + authorisation
articles.requirement: UCITS is an open-ended collective investment undertaking with the sole purpose of collective investment in transferable securities (+ other liquid financial instruments) and operating on the principle of risk-spreading. Authorised by CSSF after review of constitutional documents, prospectus, ManCo, depositary; passportable for cross-border marketing under the UCITS Directive.

articles.title: Part II UCIs — non-UCITS Lux funds
articles.requirement: UCIs authorised under Part II — not UCITS. Typical retail-permitted Lux AIF vehicle. CSSF product authorisation required; AIFM Law applies via the AIFM (post-AIFMD II amendments). Investment-policy + leverage rules less restrictive than UCITS but more demanding than SIF / SICAR / RAIF.

articles.title: UCITS Management Company authorisation
articles.requirement: UCITS ManCos require CSSF authorisation. Minimum initial capital €125,000 (+ 0.02% of AUM > €250m); 2 conducting officers; suitable shareholders + governance; risk-management + compliance + internal-audit functions. AIFMD II amends governance + delegation + LMT obligations.

articles.title: UCITS investment limits (5/10/40 rule)
articles.requirement: Maximum 5% NAV per single issuer (raisable to 10% subject to a 40% NAV cap on all 5%+ positions combined); enhanced limits for sovereign debt; eligible asset rules (transferable securities, money-market instruments, deposits, derivatives, fund units); leverage limited to 100% NAV via derivatives commitment basis or VaR.

articles.title: Depositary obligations
articles.requirement: Single depositary required — a CSSF-authorised credit institution / investment firm / specialised PSF in Luxembourg (or branch of EU credit institution). Duties: safekeeping; cash-flow monitoring; oversight of NAV calculation + subscription/redemption flows + compliance with UCITS rules. AIFMD II expands cooperation + reporting obligations + clarifies safekeeping of crypto-assets.

articles.title: Prospectus + KID + reports
articles.requirement: Each UCITS / Part II UCI must publish: full prospectus + simplified prospectus replaced by PRIIPs KID for retail clients; annual + semi-annual reports; NAV calculation rules. Material changes trigger prospectus update + investor notice. CSSF approval before any new sub-fund or material amendment.

articles.title: LMT disclosure in prospectus (post-AIFMD II)
articles.requirement: Following Bill 8628 (AIFMD II transposition), UCITS prospectuses must disclose the selected LMTs (minimum 2 from Annex V), the activation triggers + governance, and the investor-protection consequences. Prospectus updates required by 16 April 2026.

articles.title: UCITS cross-border passport
articles.requirement: Authorised UCITS may be marketed across the EU under the UCITS passport: CSSF notification of host-state regulator + provision of marketing documents in host-state language(s); ongoing compliance with marketing-communications rules (ESMA Guidelines on marketing communications). Luxembourg UCITS dominate cross-border distribution in many EU markets.

articles.title: AIFMD II delegation alignment for UCITS
articles.requirement: Bill 8628 aligns UCITS ManCo delegation rules with AIFMD II: letter-box prohibition, comprehensive delegation notification, sub-delegation transparency, particular scrutiny of out-of-EU delegation of portfolio + risk management. CSSF Circular 18/698 expectations remain authoritative.

articles.title: AIFMD II substance for UCITS ManCo
articles.requirement: Minimum 2 natural persons resident in Luxembourg dedicated to managing the UCITS ManCo, either as employees or as members of the governing body; sufficient resources for the activities; documented decision-making at the ManCo level. Reinforces existing Lux conducting-officer practice.
